programs.name: Master of Business Administration (MBA)
programs.feeNote: IFHE fee-structure page: MBA (IBS Hyderabad) 2027-29 programme fee Rs 17,01,000 for 2 years (IBS admissions page: Rs 8.505 lakh per annum). Tuition only; excludes refundable caution deposit Rs 10,000 (with 1st instalment), convocation fee Rs 4,000 (with 5th instalment) and living expenses (hostel/mess not included).
programs.intakeNote: Not published on the pages used.
programs.placementNote: IBS Final Placements page, Class of 2026, Hyderabad campus: 93% placed, highest CTC Rs 33.00 LPA, top-10% average Rs 15.58 LPA, top-25% average Rs 13.66 LPA. Batch-wide average and median not published, so both are null.

selectionProcess.name: IBSAT 2026 / CAT / XAT / NMAT / GMAT score and IBS application
selectionProcess.detail: Eligibility: bachelor's degree (15 years of education) with minimum 50%, English-medium graduation; final-year students eligible if degree completed by 31 May 2027. Application fee Rs 1,800.

selectionProcess.name: Micro Presentation and Personal Interview at IBS Hyderabad
selectionProcess.detail: Final selection on past academic record and performance in Micro Presentation and Personal Interview; selection process 2nd-3rd week of February 2027. Weights not published.

keyDates.notes: IBSAT 2026 applications 1 Jul - 22 Dec 2026; eight IBSAT test dates: 5-6, 12-13, 19-20, 26-27 Dec 2026 (examDate = first test date); selection briefings in January 2027; selection process (Micro Presentation + PI) 2nd-3rd week of February 2027 at IBS Hyderabad.

nirf.note: Ranked entity is ICFAI Foundation for Higher Education, Hyderabad (shares rank 46).
